name: Manakashi no Yuri wa Akaku Somaru
original_name: 真愛の百合は赤く染まる
source:
After relocating to a new town, Manami becomes captivated by a classmate who, intriguingly, shares her name. She tries to keep her feelings under wraps. However, the truth finds its way out, leading to an unexpected confession:

".....I'm into girls too."

With their mutual sentiments revealed, the two draw closer. Yet their relationship gradually morphs into something unsettling. How far will one Manami go to match the other's steps?

Soon enough, their private world draws others into its orbit, taking turns neither could have foreseen...

[Translated from [url=http://bug-system.com/product/04_mk/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
搬到新城镇后，真奈美被一位与她同名的同学迷住了。她试图隐藏自己的感情。然而，真相最终浮出水面，引出了意想不到的坦白：

“……我也喜欢女孩子。”

随着彼此感情的表露，两人的距离越来越近。然而他们的关系逐渐变得令人不安。一个真奈美要走多远才能追上另一个的脚步？

很快，他们的私人世界将其他人吸引到了自己的轨道上，轮流发生着双方都无法预见的事情……

[翻译自[url=http://bug-system.com/product/04_mk/]官网[/url]]
